card.name: Thresholds and citations in cardiac text
card.fires_on: Small pieces inside numeric cutoffs ("more than 10 times", "QRS≥0.12 seconds", "> 160 ms") and inside journal citations like "Lancet. 2005;365". It appears in cardiac or lab threshold phrases and in reference lists.

modes.label: Numeric cutoffs
modes.description: Words or symbols just before or inside a limit value, such as than, ≥, or a digit of an ECG interval.

modes.description: Parts of the journal name Lancet or its volume number in reference lists.
modes.example: Outpatient antibiotic use in Europe and association with resistance: a cross-national database study. Lanc<<et>>. 2005;3
